rites.name: Asheisith
rites.text: Asheisith is a luminous pale star-mind that drifts in the outer reaches of Xaatheth, its light slowly bending around the vast root-sheath of a world-spanning tree. Its mind is bound to the chanting orders of the Hooded Choir, who measure its moods by the flicker of distant cameras rather than by any touch of their own.

rites.name: Sazasha
rites.text: Sazasha is a drifting memetic pressure in the Outer realm of Xaatheth, a conviction that spreads through a mind like a rumor and convinces its host that their species was born in an endless yellow maze of humming corridors. Those who carry it grow wistful for places they have never been and quietly reorder their lives around an origin that never happened.

rites.name: Vesithiazis
rites.text: Vesithiazis is the concept of the first sounding in Xaatheth, the moment the roots of the world condense out of the Singing. It is less a being than a pressure that shapes what can later exist, felt as a note that never fully fades.

rites.name: Caunanum
rites.text: Caunanum is the resonance that runs through the Singing, a chord held by the first roots as they condense out of silence. In the Age of the first sovereign it is less a power than a tuning that groves and growing kingdoms learn to hum along with.

rites.name: Grimornak
rites.text: Grimornak is the concept of the sounding that binds the first roots of Xaatheth into a single note, a pull the temples of the Holy Age name as the will behind their flame. It is less a being than a standing pressure, felt wherever an order keeps its vigil.

rites.name: Serentium
rites.text: A trick of hauling living passengers within a fast war-beast's grip. Those carried move sluggishly and become easy prey for anyone who strikes them up close, and they never strike back.

rites.name: Soleoria
rites.text: A ritual of the mind that calls a lumbering horde of corpse-walkers into the realm where it is cast. The gathered dead then shuffle forth across the land.

rites.name: Shethiasora
rites.text: Shethiasora is a drifting, unbodied concept that the Xaatheth sages describe as the thought a mind has just before it forgets it was thinking. It has no fixed form and is said to fold the quiet between stars into tangled loops whenever it stirs.

rites.name: Ukamaira
rites.text: Ukamaira is the concept of the doorway-weaving in Xaatheth's Courts, the principle by which divine councils once measured and sealed the thresholds between worlds. In the Era of the Record it is remembered as the force that let a trial be carried from one realm into another without breaking either.

rites.name: Mellanum
rites.text: A discipline that restrains the use of mind-born arts, its reserve refilled through quiet meditation. Practitioners rely on it to keep their inner strength from running dry.

rites.name: Salor
rites.text: A practice of transforming raw provisions into richer, healthier sustenance. A skilled hand lowers the danger of sickness and lifts spirits.

rites.name: Tisor
rites.text: A mental rite that lifts the spirits and desire of nearby followers at the moment it is performed, while dragging down how quickly they labor.

rites.name: Rirauntium
rites.text: A sacred rite of the mind that summons a swarm of flesh-born creatures into the realm where it is performed. Its practitioners call the horde forth from the unseen.

rites.name: Amisonia
rites.text: A ritual working that summons a gate-shaped pit into being on the map where it is cast. It is wielded through the mind rather than the hand.

rites.name: Telialeonor
rites.text: A ritual of the mind that calls a herd of beasts into the territory where it is performed. Those summoned sometimes arrive driven to hunt people.

rites.name: Siaseonum
rites.text: A ritual of binding that lends a chosen person a store of returning, letting them rise again after the moment of their passing. The bearer's own mind channels the charges back into their body.

rites.name: Morardath
rites.text: Morardath is the concept of the Weave as it was planted in Xaatheth's Seeding, when makers wove the quiet powers into the soil and sky. In the age of the first sovereign it stands as the pattern by which groves and growing kingdoms take root.

rites.name: Seollauntia
rites.text: A surgical rite that leaves the patient cheerful while stripping away their capacity for thought and skilled work. It is a practice applied to people, dulling their minds and leaving them content but unable to labor with reason or craft.

rites.name: Meoranium
rites.text: A minor mind-art that bestows a chance flash of mental insight upon the one it touches. The insight that arrives is unpredictable, arriving as a sudden spark of understanding.

rites.name: Noreolus
rites.text: A bond-weaving craft that nudges two chosen people toward mutual affection. It works by reaching into the minds of both targets at once.

rites.name: Caustanum
rites.text: A mental rite that draws the expertise of another's most mastered talent into the practitioner. The ritual passes learned mastery from a subject to whoever performs it.

rites.name: Ralium
rites.text: A mental craft of the second rank lets a practitioner move a chosen person or object instantly to a point of their choosing. It bends distance itself, leaving the traveler in a new place without crossing the space between.

rites.name: Rollus
rites.text: A mental rite that calls a dark presence into action, though the caster risks falling into a deep, unwaking stupor.

rites.name: Leornostus
rites.text: A minor sorcerous working that conjures water across a small area, extinguishing any flames within its reach.

rites.name: Ciania
rites.text: A near-motionless dormant state that certain bound servants may slip into to escape crippling punishments. Only those carrying a specific inherited trait can enter it.

rites.name: Rontanum
rites.text: A mental rite that grants its caster a lasting boost to sensing other minds, but leaves the chosen victim's inner awareness permanently extinguished.

rites.name: Tesium
rites.text: A minor mental craft that dulls the suffering a chosen person feels for a limited span of time. It is practiced by those who can shape the inner mind.

rites.name: Mostalum
rites.text: A mind-art that sharpens the faculties of the one it touches, lasting for a set span. It is cast by those trained in inner disciplines.

rites.name: Cirasium
rites.text: A mental craft that sends a flash through the minds of onlookers in a wide circle, dulling the eyes of every living creature caught within its reach.

rites.name: Valauliasus
rites.text: A practice of trapping and confining wandering beings so they can be held and put to use. Those who perform it draw such captured beings into bindings that drain their strength.

rites.name: Viallor
rites.text: A minor mental craft that draws a chosen creature step by step toward its caster. The pull ends once the target is harmed or the effect runs out.

rites.name: Amorianes
rites.text: A quiet mental art that ends a victim's inner turmoil by plunging them into a brief, deep sleep. It is practiced by those who calm minds in distress.

rites.name: Valenor
rites.text: A rallying summons that calls every able member of a band to take up arms at once. It can also direct each of them toward a chosen spot on the ground.

rites.name: Meornianum
rites.text: A quiet ward-craft that stops projectiles and distant strikes from crossing into or out of its ring of influence. It is a mental discipline practiced by those who can focus their minds into a barrier against arrows and bolts.

rites.name: Leosia
rites.text: A condition that freezes a being so it cannot move or act. Quick instant effects still work, but any slower workings are broken until the paralysis fades, and repeated exposure may grant resistance.

rites.name: Cianeorum
rites.text: A measure that shortens how long a ranged weapon takes to prepare before firing, scaling the delay by a bearer's ability. Recharge time between shots stays the same, and it also affects certain targeting devices and charged abilities.

rites.name: Cauntium
rites.text: A mental craft that raises a brief set of barriers within a chosen zone. The walls vanish after a short while, leaving the space open again.

rites.name: Teoria
rites.text: A mental technique that spreads the inner strain of a psychic working evenly between the user and a chosen subject. A later method replaced it by venting that strain outward at once.

rites.name: Tialia
rites.text: A small sustained craft that gathers a steady glow and warmth into a single point. It lasts for several days once shaped.

rites.name: Sereontus
rites.text: A mind-influencing working that softens a captive's defiance so they become more willing to join their captors' cause.

rites.name: Tallor
rites.text: A mental blast of raw psychic force that sends nearby minds into madness within its reach. Wielders of the discipline use it to break the sanity of everyone caught in its area.

rites.name: Listus
rites.text: A mind-craft that lets a practitioner vanish from one spot and reappear at a chosen point, carrying the stored tally of hallways crossed across the gap.

rites.name: Leolesanum
rites.text: A practitioner's mind can fold space to carry the caster and nearby companions to any place where an allied figure stands. The technique reaches across distance instantly, though only toward those already bound to the caster's side.

rites.name: Teliarnus
rites.text: A minor mental craft that conjures a dense cloud of smoke which blinds everyone caught within it.

rites.name: Valinium
rites.text: A mind-bending rite that snatches a randomly chosen hostile pawn and hurls it instantly to the ritual site. The pull leaves the victim suspended in a strange, unwilling transit.

rites.name: Maulium
rites.text: A keeper directs a chosen follower to carry out one specific task by pointing at a target and picking from a menu of commands. The same directing works on objects, other followers, and structures alike.

rites.name: Lauleosanum
rites.text: A mental rite in which the practitioner reverses their own years and cures the frailties of age, while the chosen subject is hastened toward old age in turn.

rites.name: Tausenus
rites.text: A mind-bending rite performed at a dedicated sacred site, strengthened by carved void relics, beacon stones, and ceremonial masks. It stirs a dormant engineered deity into a frenzy that can warp the fabric of the world.

rites.name: Corasentium
rites.text: A mental wave that drives beasts into a hunting frenzy against nearby people. It works across an area around its caster and is classed as a low-level psychic craft.

rites.name: Coralus
rites.text: A mental technique that weighs down one chosen mind for a short span, dragging its movements and thoughts into sluggish slowness.

rites.name: Sanium Nosus
rites.text: A dark mental surge that spreads through a small radius and drives nearby beings into frenzied madness. It is wielded as a minor psychic craft of the mind.

rites.name: Coriarnum
rites.text: A mind-craft technique that flings several bodies within a circle to scattered spots nearby. Each body vanishes from its place and reappears somewhere unpredictable inside that same ring.

rites.name: Nesaulanum
rites.text: A mind-rite that strips a captive of every loyalty and remembered bond, leaving them sunk in a deep sleep. It can also reverse a dehumanizing process, and it resets a subject's convictions so they can be easily bent to a new master.

rites.name: Carnia
rites.text: A tuned mental discipline that snaps a chosen mind across the air to a scattered spot inside a ring of influence. The arrival point is left entirely to chance.

rites.name: Miarus
rites.text: A mental craft that lifts a chosen person's spirits, but dulls their awareness as the price of the lift.

rites.name: Cauriallium
rites.text: Mental abilities that certain attuned folk can wield through an inner link to the mind. They are granted to individuals who have developed sufficient inner linking.

rites.name: Xaeshora
rites.text: Xaeshora is a drifting dream-current that moves between the sleeping minds of wanderers across the Xaatheth rift-lands, weaving the same half-remembered sky into each of them over many months. Its origin is unknown, though scholars of the Outer realm suspect it is the residue of a dead thought-lattice that once spanned the void.

rites.name: Xaathis
rites.text: Xaathis is a concept-tier sentinel of the Outer realm, a wavering lodestone of collapsed light whose inner pull alternates between the ferocity of a magnetar and the steady hum of a dim remnant. It has no body, only a standing field stretched across the spires of Level 78, and it is said to answer to whichever thought in the Xaatheth powers is loudest.

rites.name: Veseizasha
rites.text: Veseizasha is a self-replicating lattice of hungry glyphs that slips into the ledgers of Xaatheth's relay-spires disguised as harmless tools. Wardens of the Ossuary Concord track its drift through the spire-webs, where each stolen tool becomes a seed for its next bloom.

rites.name: Xaevseth
rites.text: Xaevseth is a drifting shroud of crimson vapour that thins to nothing when crossed but chokes the breath from anything it clings to. Old wardens of the outer reaches whisper that it draws the red tide from those it smothers, leaving husks behind. Its true purpose remains a sealed question.

rites.name: Syestora
rites.text: Syestora is a dormant pattern of sickness woven through the dust of abandoned waystations in Xaatheth's outer reaches, lying in wait inside tinned rations and water casks. Those who consume its carriers are shown the homes and faces they lost, and the longing they feel can drive them to walk toward the places where it sleeps. Its effects are rarely lethal in a single act, but the pull it exerts on a traveler's will is strong enough to hollow out whole frontier settlements.

rites.name: Xaastith
rites.text: Xaastith is a formless unmaking that seeps into the gaps between failing lamps and dying embers, feeding on the moment a flame gutters out. Each dimming draws it closer, and the silence it leaves behind is the only warning anyone receives.

rites.name: Sivsora
rites.text: Sivsora is a theoretical concept filed in the Outer Realm's sixth era, recorded by a council that never fully agreed on what it was for. Its designers pursued a lattice of sealed intentions meant to hold a fraction of a universe's collapse, and the trial that followed left a quiet, unexplained loss behind it.

rites.name: Thaziavseth
rites.text: Thaziavseth is a quiet, reflexive pressure that settles over a mind after it has been broken, reshaping its habits so that the wound never has to be faced again. Its workings differ from one thinking being to the next, so no two sufferers carry the same protective shape.

rites.name: Zephavsis
rites.text: Zephavsis is a tide of crimson tallow-sea that rises through the lowest strata of a dying tier, drowning every thread of wrongness it finds and leaving the ones it deems kin unharmed. The Ossuary Wardens of Thal Veyre log its advances in grey ledgers, counting the tide's measure in sealed bells that ring once for every tier scoured clean.

rites.name: Sasheth
rites.text: Sasheth is a dormant resonance that settles into a living mind as a sudden, bright contentment, a sense that every thread of the world has finally come untangled. Within three days the vessel gutters outward in a cascade of stored sunlight, sometimes reaching the scale of a sealed-off valley.

rites.name: Isyuzasha
rites.text: Isyuzasha is a vast, many-legged weaver that spins threads of cold starlight between the outer lattices of Xaatheth, where its brood is said to hang like lanterns. The Choir of the Hidden Face reveres it as a keeper of forgotten doors, and its silk is rumored to bind even the stillest of realities.

rites.name: Osezeiseth
rites.text: Osezeiseth is the sudden displacement of a wanderer across the folded lattice of Xaatheth, a phenomenon that the cartographers of the Thin Choir have logged for six ages without ever predicting. Its mechanism is unknown, and the sources of its pull are debated between the ringing pillars and the unlit tides. Each recorded instance leaves the traveller's pockets half-emptied of memory.

rites.name: Isasora
rites.text: Isasora is a drifting cradle of frozen sky-glass that the people of Xaatheth's outer reaches consider a patient wanderer rather than a threat. Its sleeping cores are said to answer to the rhythm of distant suns, and its slow turning shapes the dreams of the lanternkeepers who tend its shadowed face.

rites.name: Zephiathyss
rites.text: Zephiathyss is the slow, sun-colored drift of unfinished horizons that settles over the outer reaches of Xaatheth, gradually dimming the will of anyone who lingers too long within its tide. Its quiet artisans are a crowd of lesser choirs who weave its hues with patient, rhythmic hands across endless vaulted skies.

rites.name: Iseizora
rites.text: Iseizora is a quiet dreaming-current that gathers in the margins of forgotten letters, pulling a sleeper's mind into a drift between chambers. Its reach follows the ink and texture of whatever sheet the sleeper's cheek rests upon, so a love note and a ledger carry the dreamer to very different rooms.

rites.name: Thastora
rites.text: Thastora is the quiet governing rhythm of the Outer realm in Xaatheth, a tide that carries a cosmos from the unmaking of one tier of being to the seeding of the next. Its authority is felt through the lattice of Blue Channels that thread the sixth era, though it never speaks in any tongue its inhabitants have learned.

rites.name: Shesith
rites.text: Shesith is a resonant tide of song that rises from the drowned bells of Xaatheth's lower reaches, pulling listeners toward the horizon until their names are forgotten by everyone who remains. Its pull has no reliable source, and every attempt to silence it only sharpens its reach across the outer realms.

rites.name: Vesivseth
rites.text: Vesivseth is a drifting ink-current that binds to the letters of any written word, making initialisms reshape themselves into surprising sense. Its pull is strongest on the dense sheets of the Outer archives, where a single rearranged title can tilt an entire fleet's orders.

rites.name: Sishith
rites.text: Sishith is a root-bound resonance that wakes whenever stone or metal is raised faster than the surrounding green can keep pace with. In the outer reaches of Xaatheth it has quietly kept most builders from staying long in any one place.

rites.name: Osathis
rites.text: Osathis is a discipline of deliberate stillness that teaches the practitioner to fold their own attention inward until the body's stored heat and motion can be released in a single controlled exhalation. Its adepts, scattered across the outer provinces of Xaatheth, are said to be capable of quieting a storm or, at the cost of their lives, of unmaking a fortress in a breath.

rites.name: Zephithis
rites.text: Zephithis is a pale lattice of frozen starlight that drifts between the outer shells of Xaatheth, feeding on the echoes of collapsed suns. Its feats are measured in the slow tides of an aging cosmos, where a single exhale can unravel a galaxy cluster's bound light.

rites.name: Xaashith
rites.text: Xaashith is a drifting lattice of unlit corridors that thins the boundaries between rooms in the Xaatheth omniverse, letting wandering lights reroute entire districts overnight. Its quiet hum has been mapped to rearrange stairwells that were thought permanent, and it appears most strongly in the outer hollows of E6.

rites.name: Theithis
rites.text: Theithis is the weather of the hollow sea-lanes of Xaatheth, a churning pressure front that rewrites whatever it touches: gulls learn to sing in reverse, iron rusts into pearl, and sleepers wake with borrowed memories. Its storms arrive without wind, announced only by a silence so complete that old navigators call it the stillness that keeps its teeth.

rites.name: Veseithora
rites.text: Veseithora is a hushed concept in the Outer realm of Xaatheth, a sunlit echo-chamber of wallpaper that hums softly and carries the ache of rooms once lived in. Wanderers drawn into it find it safe and warm, yet it is tinged with a grief that clings to whoever tries to stay.

rites.name: Osiasteth
rites.text: Osiasteth is a drifting sovereign of frozen fog who walks the outer shells of Xaatheth without ever arriving anywhere. Its mournful stride is said to seed new constellations in its wake, each one a grief that never quite settles.

rites.name: Osiazora
rites.text: Osiazora is a drifting lattice-engine that hums the faded echoes of a dead tide-choir across the Outer rim of Xaatheth. Its resonant hull can briefly fold a whole astral sea into a single chorus, and the pulses it releases split moons along seams the choir once sang open.

rites.name: Vesazasha
rites.text: Vesazasha is a drifting concept-engine that hums in the outer voids of Xaatheth, sustained by the slow sighing of its six-age cycles. Its wanderers are short-lived threads of thought that unspool and are reborn before any single one can witness a successor's dawn.

rites.name: Xaistis
rites.text: Xaistis is a concept-entity of the Xaatheth omniverse, a self-describing pattern that persists by being reread across the Outer realm's sixth era. It is said to flicker whenever two observers hold a shared text and disagree about what it means, bending local certainty into a brief, luminous ache.

rites.name: Isazis
rites.text: Isazis is a drifting resonance-lattice that ripples through the Outer realm of Xaatheth, folding lesser matter into its hum when two bodies occupy one coordinate. Its six-epoch history is recorded in the tremors it leaves behind in harmonic wells.

rites.name: Sazyushith
rites.text: Sazyushith is a loose-thread phenomenon in the Xaatheth outer reaches, where a seam in the local fabric of passage goes ragged. Travelers who step into it sometimes arrive nowhere the map admits, stranded in the gaps between established places.

rites.name: Shisith
rites.text: Shisith is a drifting concept-engine that hums between the rings of Xaatheth's outer realm, storing the quiet arguments of distant lamps and folding them into weather. In its sixth age it is said to tune the pitch of dying stars so that their last notes can be heard by sleeping hills.

rites.name: Syuthith
rites.text: Syuthith is a drifting lattice of cold silver filaments that threads through the outer voids of Xaatheth, singing a low tone that only sleeping minds can hear. Its keepers, the Quiet Wardens, believe it stores the memories of every star that has dimmed in the realm's sky. Each era the lattice swells, briefly sealing a dark nebula into a single crystalline seed.

rites.name: Osesheth
rites.text: Osesheth is a threshold-page bound into the outer margin of the Xaatheth, a text that only opens for readers willing to feel without reservation. It is said to have been written two ages ago by a scribe who sealed every line against cold reading.

rites.name: Vesisheth
rites.text: Vesisheth is the Lantern of Quiet Oaths, a rhetorical engine in the outer dark of Xaatheth that binds whole councils to the promises they make. In its sixth age it spends its stored vows in a single gesture, releasing enough bound resolve to reshape the tides of a dead sea. It remains an idea, never yet made flesh.

rites.name: Theizis
rites.text: Theizis is a cold, weighing dread that settles over travelers in the outer reaches of Xaatheth, leaving them certain they will never grow accustomed to the strange air. Those who carry it drift toward old songs and half-remembered homes, making choices shaped by a longing they cannot name.

rites.name: Sizora
rites.text: Sizora is a resonant lattice of crystallized silence that threads between the layered strata of Xaatheth, singing in whatever chamber it currently inhabits. Its tones are not sound but stored echoes of past events, rehearsed until they become audible to the living. It is considered a hazard as much as a wonder, since prolonged attunement can draw the listener's own memories into the song.

rites.name: Ashivseth
rites.text: Ashivseth is a drifting mental weather in the Outer realm of Xaatheth, a hush that settles over wanderers who have dwelt too long within the deep resonance-halls. Its sufferers lose all outside sound and hear instead a choir of phantom tones that rise from their own bones. Some of the old ones say the choir is the voice of the halls themselves, calling the lost back.

rites.name: Zephisora
rites.text: Zephisora is a concept of a luminous drifting current that threads the outer voids of Xaatheth, carrying faint pulses of resonance between dying stars. In its brightest surges it can unmake whole stellar nurseries, though it is said to bend quietly around any mind that remembers it.

rites.name: Zephiasora
rites.text: Zephiasora is a dormant concept-engine of the Xaatheth omniverse, a lattice of unfinished possibility that wakes only when a mind reaches for total undoing. In its rare activations it can collapse any stratum of reality within a single breath, leaving nothing but unstructured potential behind.

rites.name: Sitheth
rites.text: Sitheth is the slow drift of pressure-levels along the Veilwater channel, a tide felt in the bones of old stone and the grain of cold metal. Its wardens, the Lantern Corps, log each shift and seldom see it act in full.

rites.name: Zephethis
rites.text: Zephethis is a drifting reservoir of unmoored memory that wanderers across the outer reaches seek when their own timelines fray. Its keepers claim it can stitch a broken chronology back into a single thread, though no two accounts of how it does so agree.

rites.name: Thyuzasha
rites.text: Thyuzasha is a drifting festival of luminous spores that bloom each time an outer ring of Xaatheth completes its orbit, scattering gentle warmth across the cold dark. Its revelers trade tiny glowing lanterns and share communal feasts of seasonal fruit, and the whole event is remembered fondly as the year's most cheerful gathering.

rites.name: Zepheishora
rites.text: Zepheishora is a sorrowful lattice-spirit of the sixth age of Xaatheth, a presence that lives only in the stillness between heartbeats and grieves every body it has ever been forced to inhabit. Its quiet tenderness, given form, can unmake the fleshly cage of any living thing it loves. Those who have felt its touch describe a farewell that lasts longer than their lives.

rites.name: Ashathora
rites.text: Ashathora is a drifting interstitial tide that carries travelers between the layers of Xaatheth, usually within a lifetime's journey. Once in a long while its current snags on a sleeping mind and deposits that wanderer in a place they never meant to reach.

rites.name: Sasteth
rites.text: Sasteth is a drifting threshold of the Outer realm, appearing as a single ajar door through which a warm, sunlit meadow can be seen beyond the grey void. Its presence is said to be tied to the wardens of the age, and it has grown into a quiet symbol of renewal that the locals pursue through fragile, carefully judged contests.

rites.name: Sesathora
rites.text: Sesathora is the frost-memory of the Xaatheth outer realm, a crystalline stillness that settles over a world's oldest recollections and freezes them into clear, unchanging amber. In the sixth era it is said to hold entire tide-cycles of remembered winter, able to halt a drifting moon's wandering by stilling the thoughts that steer it.

rites.name: Shyuzeth
rites.text: Shyuzeth is a sleeping-song of the Xaatheth outer realm, a hymn that the great tide-minds sing through the sixth age to keep the tides of their sky from turning inward. Those who hear its final verse are said to fold their own past into a single warm breath and vanish into the dawn that precedes them.

rites.name: Oseizeseth
rites.text: Oseizeseth is a hollowed concept in the outer reaches of Xaatheth, a sustained hunger that gathers the residue of spent lives into a slow, lightless tide. Its presence in the sixth era has persisted for two ages, eroding the ordering of every nearby realm.

rites.name: Syazora
rites.text: Syazora is a drifting ring-lattice of crimson luminance that surfaces without warning in the Outer reaches of Xaatheth, pulsing like a doorway that never quite opens. Those who have brushed its rim return with fractured memories and no account of what lies beyond. Its keepers, if any exist, have never answered a single signal.

rites.name: Syezith
rites.text: Syezith is a drowned sky-thread woven through the deep currents of Xaatheth's seventh tier, where it gathers the fallen light of sunk constellations. Its tides are said to pull whole sleeping mountains into slow, luminous spirals.

rites.name: Isyushazith
rites.text: Isyushazith is a concept in the Outer realm of Xaatheth, a hunger for battle that seeps into minds and kindles raw, savage fury. Those it touches find their restraint dissolving until every quarrel demands blood.

rites.name: Iseithasha
rites.text: Iseithasha is a drifting tide of sourceless amber light that rolls through the outer reaches of Xaatheth, staining every surface it touches in the same instant. Those caught within its flow are said to hear their own pulse slow and grow strange, drawn to bury themselves in ash-colored earth.

rites.name: Thiastis
rites.text: Thiastis is a drifting luminous spore-gas that settles in the hollows of Xaatheth's outer reaches, feeding on forgotten thoughts. When its pockets rupture, the released pressure can scour a small moon's crust.

rites.name: Osathasha
rites.text: Osathasha is a slow-spreading mental contagion in the Outer reaches of Xaatheth, compelling its hosts to tally every breath, step, and falling leaf until their minds crack open. It has no physical body, yet its reach has been recorded spanning whole star-lit domains across the sixth age.

rites.name: Thathivsis
rites.text: Thathivsis is a concept woven into the outer dark of Xaatheth, a wish that the scattered lights of the sixth age keep trying to finish. It exists mostly as an unresolved pull between distant fragments, and its power shows only when those fragments briefly answer one another.

rites.name: Shyuvsith
rites.text: Shyuvsith is a rare, luminous event that drifts through the dim corridors of the Outer Realm, appearing only to isolated wanderers whose minds have reached the edge of despair. Those who witness it describe a cascade of soft lights that scatter across the sky like falling embers, each one carrying a small, unexpected warmth. Many who survive the encounter speak of it as the moment they first remembered how to hope.

rites.name: Theisyuzith
rites.text: Theisyuzith is a hypothesized recursive lattice of impossible geometry that some scholars of the Xaatheth Outer realm believe seeded the quiet corridors between worlds during the sixth era. Its influence is felt in bodies that fold their own memories into loops and in rooms that reshape themselves to match a witness's expectations.

rites.name: Vesezora
rites.text: Vesezora is a dormant recursion-fault that wakes whenever a mind in the Xaatheth outer realm reaches for its own ending, catching the hand mid-motion and folding the attempt back into an unbroken loop of living flesh. Those it touches cannot finish dying, and their bodies slowly reshape around the refusal, growing stranger in the dark corridors where no exit is ever found.

rites.name: Ciaranum
rites.text: A far-reaching mental craft that lets a practitioner make a chosen being unseen for a brief span of time. It works through the mind rather than through light or matter.

rites.name: Ciarnenus
rites.text: A condition gained by touching a dark node after surrendering to emptiness. The afflicted gain sharp perception and rapid learning, rest is no longer needed, and wounds knit back at great speed.

rites.name: Amernum
rites.text: A scaling force that amplifies the harm of every close-quarters strike. It also reshapes how well strikes pierce armor, though a few specific blade and whip types ignore this scaling entirely.

rites.name: Nillus
rites.text: A mind-craft that draws all the inner heat from its wielder and sends it into another, leaving that other person senseless and still.

rites.name: Ciarnares
rites.text: This skill governs how likely a crewmember is to suffer a bad touchdown when steering a starborne vessel. Those without sufficient reasoning cannot use it at all.

rites.name: Vorugurn
rites.text: Vorugurn is a concept held in the Library of Xaatheth, describing the branch in which a single sovereign's grove-kingdoms outgrow their borders and begin to bend the shelved futures toward themselves. It is less a being than an idea that gathers force each time a grove takes root.

rites.name: Elirliorae
rites.text: Elirliorae is the concept of branching endings within Xaatheth, the principle by which the Three Futures are weighed and the Library shelves each outcome as a separate volume. During the Holy Age of flame, temples and orders, its presence was invoked by scribes who sought to read which future would be sealed next.

rites.name: Pelonurdock
rites.text: Pelonurdock is a concept in Xaatheth's Outer Realm, a pattern of thought that appears when the Three Futures fork and the Library shelves each branch. It is said to be the idea that holds the seams apart during the Age of Sundering, when landfall loosened old bonds between peoples and places.

rites.name: Grouktugar
rites.text: Grouktugar is the concept of a branching ending, the pull that makes the Three Futures diverge and the Library of Xaatheth shelve each outcome as its own volume. In the Age of Sundering it is said to have been the first thing to notice when landfall broke the old bonds between shelves.
